name: humanmade/uat-checklist
description: Testing checklists for user acceptance testing: testers mark each step Pass or Fail, and the results are stored on the site.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHPCS and PHPStan over the plugin.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Auto-fix the coding standard violations that are fixable.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run static analysis at PHPStan level 5.
